scenes.script:
Priya says: Main English read aur write toh perfectly fine kar leti hoon.
Miss Nova says: Lekin jab actually English speak karne ka time aata hai, toh kya aap freeze ho jaate ho?
Priya says: Haan! Mujhe bahut sharm aati hai. Maine itne saare courses try kiye hain, par kuch kaam nahi karta.
Miss Nova says: Kyunki un courses mein, aapne kabhi actually speak nahi kiya. Main hoon Miss Nova, Supernova AI par aapki AI teacher.
Priya says: Ek AI teacher? Bhala koi AI mujhe speak karna kaise sikha sakta hai?
Miss Nova says: Main aapko bas generic lessons nahi deti. Main aapko speak karte hue sunti hoon, aapki exact struggle dhoondti hoon, aur aapke liye ek personalized plan ready karti hoon.
Priya says: Par agar main mistakes karoon toh? Mujhe embarrassed feel hota hai.
Miss Nova says: Aap mere saath raat ke 2 a.m. par bhi practice kar sakte ho. Hazaaron mistakes karo, main aapko correct karungi bina judge kiye ya aap par hanse.
Priya says: Sach mein? Aur aap sab kuch aise explain karoge ki mujhe samajh aa jaye?
Miss Nova says: Haan, main logic seedhe aapki apni language Hindi mein explain karti hoon. 1 crore+ Indians mere saath pehle se practice kar rahe hain.
Priya says: Yeh toh sach mein amazing lag raha hai.
Miss Nova says: Videos scroll karne mein ghanton waste karna band karo. Bas mere saath roz 15 minutes practice karo. Supernova AI install karo aur aaj se hi speak karna start karo.

parsed.self_critique_fixed: The script has been successfully translated to romanized, code-mixed Hindi following all global and language-specific rules. The hook opens with a native word ('Main') rather than an English word. Miss Nova maintains a warm, polite 'aap' register throughout. All specified stay-English words (such as 'English', 'speak', 'practice', 'personalized plan', 'AI teacher', 'Supernova AI') and numerals ('2 a.m.', '1 crore+', '15 minutes') have been strictly preserved. The translation maintains a natural, spoken register (T3) and avoids any textbook-style or overly formal Hindi.

violations.scene: SCENE 1 — Video Call with AI Tutor
violations.quote: At the bottom of the screen, a dark translucent bar houses standard video call control icons, including a camera toggle, microphone mute, a red end-call button, an add-user icon, and a more-options menu.
violations.why: The inclusion of interactive-looking video call control buttons mimics a functional user interface, which violates Meta's policy against fake UI and misleading mechanics.
violations.fix: Remove the interactive video call control icons from the bottom bar, presenting the AI tutor interface as a clean, non-interactive video playback or chat screen.

safety.summary: The ad is mostly compliant but contains a severe Meta policy violation (G4.2) due to simulated interactive video call controls in the visual description.
